scope: Historical saved Lookout match-phase CPU samples, before 0.1.14. Not a before/after FPS benchmark.
method: Older saved whole-machine CPU values were mistakenly divided a second time by 20. Multiply their rounded values by 20 to reconstruct an approximation.
limitations: Saved values were rounded; these reconstructed percentages are approximate.
One machine and historical samples; not representative of every user.
No FPS, 1% low or mouse-latency measurements.
Not evidence of live-game performance after the 0.1.14 changes.
